dct_title_s: A MAP of the WORLD, on wch. is Delineated the Voyages of ROBINSON CRUSO
dct_description_sm: California as an island with an indented northern coast. The map shows the track of Crusoe’s voyage around the world. Off of north coast of South America can be seen “R. Crusoes I.”
Issued in: The farther adventures of Robinson Crusoe... / Daniel Defoe. -- London: Printed for W. Taylor at the Ship in Pater-Noster-Row. MDCCXIX. (1719).
Post publication map number with latest state information: 1058-01
State 2: “Fronting the title of the II Vol.” (upper right).
